Price 26,000 gp; Slot head; Weight 1 lb.; Capacity 10; Usage 1 charge per scan

Celmak's own mind-scanning optics, salvaged from her body. The party gets it only if Celmak is destroyed, surrenders, or hands it over as part of a deal. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Sense Motive checks. As a standard action, the wearer can scan one creature within 60 feet, as @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.Item.xllxylvvqr82o2d5]{detect thoughts} with all three rounds of information gained at once (Will DC 20 negates).

Construction Requirements Craft Technological Item, military lab; Cost 13,000 gp; Craft DC 28.

Found in: Celmak (the Cutting Room).
